title: Shaoyn OpenFit 2 AI Earphones Shocking Launch: Integrates Qianwen Large Model, 48-Hour Long Battery Life Redefines Smart Audio Experience

content_html:
At a time when artificial intelligence is deeply empowering hardware terminals, open-ear headphones have also entered the era of large models. Shao Yin has officially launched its new masterpiece - OpenFit2AI earphones. This product not only continues the brand's advantages in the field of open acoustic technology, but also deeply integrates the Qianwen AI large model. The initial selling price is 1398 yuan, offering users a new experience that combines comfortable wear and powerful intelligent interaction.

 Exquisite Design and Comfortable Wear

In terms of appearance and structure, Shao Yin OpenFit2 adopts a classic open structure design. Each earphone weighs only 9.4 grams and has an IP55 level of protection certification. The ear hook part cleverly uses a dolphin arc shape, embedded with a 0.7 mm flexible titanium wire, which can securely fit various ear shapes. On the surface that comes into contact with the skin, the earphones are covered with a double-layer ultra-zero-degree silicone material, ensuring excellent softness and comfort even with long-term wear.

 Powerful AI Voice and Scenario Translation Capabilities

The core highlight of this earphone lies in its outstanding AI voice processing capabilities. The device supports quick initiation of recording through the earphone itself, the closed charging box, or the dedicated app. It can support up to 8 hours of voice recording at a time. The system is equipped with 12 professional industry vocabulary libraries, supporting accurate transcription of 30 languages and 19 dialects, and provides four translation modes such as face-to-face communication and simultaneous interpretation, automatically generating multidimensional AI meeting or conversation summaries for users.

 Excellent Acoustics and Stable Connection Performance

In terms of acoustic configuration and connection performance, the earphones are equipped with a 21mm by 11mm composite diaphragm unit, combined with a dedicated bass algorithm and directional sound transmission technology, comprehensively optimizing the listening experience and effectively reducing sound leakage. At the same time, it supports four-microphone call noise reduction function, uses Bluetooth 5.4 technology, and supports dual-device simultaneous connection, ensuring stable and clear audio transmission.

 Long Battery Life and Fast Charging Support

In terms of battery life, the Shao Yin OpenFit2 performs excellently, with a single earphone music playback time of up to 11 hours, and a total battery life of up to 48 hours with the charging case. The standby time of the entire machine in full charge state can reach as long as 270 days. In addition, the product supports fast charging technology, requiring only 10 minutes of charging to meet 2 hours of listening needs.
